cases.test_name: REQ-1: SCN-REQ-1-01 Display the signed-out homepage
cases.given: The visitor has no session credential.
cases.then: Register and Login links are visible with href values /register and /login; no password input or authentication session cookie is present; no same-origin mutating request is issued during homepage load.
assertions: No same-origin POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE request occurs during homepage load
No authentication-like session cookie is created

cases.test_name: REQ-1: SCN-REQ-1-01 Refresh keeps the visitor signed out
cases.given: The visitor has no session credential and the signed-out homepage is displayed.
cases.then: Register and Login links remain visible with href values /register and /login; no password input or authentication session cookie is created.
assertions: Register link remains visible after refresh
Login link remains visible after refresh
No password input is present after refresh
No authentication-like session cookie is created after refresh

uncovered_requirements.reason: A valid existing session must display the exact username and hide Register and Login. No session fixture, cookie name, session API endpoint, or username display selector/accessible name is provided, so this state cannot be established or asserted.
An unrecognized session must leave the visitor signed out. No valid/invalid session cookie format or session lookup endpoint is specified, so an unrecognized session cannot be reliably constructed.

Do not briefly display a previously cached username while session identity is unresolved. This requires knowledge of the session lookup request and username display locator to intercept or delay resolution; neither is provided.
A failed session lookup must not leave a stale authenticated display. No session lookup endpoint or failure-injection mechanism is specified.

Display no authenticated username. No username display selector, accessible name, or DOM contract is provided. The test verifies signed-out entry links and absence of auth cookies/password inputs, but cannot positively assert absence of username text.

No passwords, password hashes, or session credentials are displayed. The test checks for no password inputs and no authentication-like cookies, but cannot exhaustively prove that no credential text appears elsewhere without known credential display contracts.

assumptions: The Playwright baseURL points to the application root and the home page is available at /.
A fresh Playwright browser context has no session credential; context.clearCookies() ensures the signed-out precondition.
The homepage exposes navigation links with accessible names exactly 'Register' and 'Login' and href attributes exactly '/register' and '/login'.
A same-origin POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE request during homepage load would indicate account/session mutation and is therefore treated as a violation of the read-only homepage requirement.
Authentication-like cookies are identified by names matching /session|auth|token|jwt|sid|user/i; absence of such cookies is used as evidence that no session was created.
The signed-out state is also evidenced by both Register and Login links remaining visible; the username display element is unknown and therefore not directly asserted.
